name: 作業一覧と承認詳細の分割画面
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. LH09-0050 COLOR/SURFACE-ONLY correction.
In image1, make the approval visibility notice band and the ENTIRE comments/footer region backgrounds pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF, same as main page. Keep all outlines/dividers/text legible. These ordinary surfaces must not be gray/tinted.
Change the dark list glyph inside the top-left green project square to WHITE, and make that square a restrained forest-green #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E gradient, no bright mint.
Everything else unchanged: split proportions, selected pale-blue row, original source icon geometry from image2, all Japanese content and values, controls, states, portraits/avatars, dates, counters, rows, fields, empty comment input and footer. No extra card or overlay; no layout/text/font edits.
reviewNotes: White notice/comments and white-on-forest project glyph corrected; all split-screen values/states/toolbar/fields/footer rechecked. Nested child-add label, parent dependency counter glyph, unchecked/circled-check state, portrait/type fidelity remain after two bounded attempts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
